sources.entry: Aastro - Extensible API Gateway written in Go. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: Aastro is a YAML-configured API gateway written in Go that fans out one HTTP request to several upstream services in parallel and returns a merged, namespaced, or arrayed response.
keywords: combine multiple api calls into one
summary.what_it_does: Aastro receives an HTTP request on a configured route and calls several upstream services in parallel, then returns one response that is merged, namespaced, or placed in an array, according to an aggregation strategy. Each upstream can have its own timeout, retry policy, and circuit breaker, and hosts can be balanced with round_robin or least_conns. With best_effort enabled, it returns 206 Partial Content and an X-Partial-Errors header when some upstreams fail. The README also describes streaming flows for SSE and chunked responses, per-IP sliding-window rate limiting, and TLS/mTLS on the inbound port and per upstream, with certificate hot-reload. Builtin middlewares include auth (JWT), cors, compressor, logger, and recoverer, and custom request/response plugins are loaded as Go .so files. The aastroctl companion tool exports the gateway config to OpenAPI 3.x and imports OpenAPI documents into a starter config. Metrics are exposed via Prometheus or OTLP, and health and readiness endpoints run on a separate admin port.
use_cases: combine several microservice calls into one client response
put a gateway in front of internal microservices
return partial data when one backend is down
generate an OpenAPI spec from gateway config
scaffold gateway config from an existing OpenAPI file
add JWT auth or rate limiting in front of services
run mutual TLS between gateway and backends
how_to_run: make all GOOS=<os> GOARCH=<arch>  (requires CGO_ENABLED=1 and a C toolchain)
notable: Declarative aggregation: fan out to multiple upstreams and merge, namespace, or array the results from YAML alone, with no code required for a route
Best-effort mode returns 206 Partial Content with X-Partial-Errors when some upstreams fail
Zero-downtime TLS certificate rotation that watches certificate directories and keeps the previous material if a new cert fails to parse
aastroctl converts gateway config to OpenAPI 3.1/3.0 and back, with deterministic output suitable for git and CI
Config validation with aastro -t / -T before deployment
caveats: Version 0.x: the configuration schema may change in minor versions, so the README advises pinning an exact image tag
Building from source requires CGO_ENABLED=1 and a C toolchain because plugins are Go shared objects
Plugins must be compiled with the exact Go version and dependency set used for the gateway binary
